g.text: Effect Redis median throughput as a percentage of each competitor

g.text: 100% = equal throughput; 80% = 20% lower throughput. Each cell matches its workload and backend.

g.text: Four fresh-process trials per case · rotated client order · local TCP / RESP2 · 1 s warm-up + 3 s samples
